technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with bullish MACD/PPO crossovers and trend confirmation, but weakened by price below 50-day moving averages, negative money flow, and overbought stochastic RSI in neutral sector environment.

fundamental.summary: QRVO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 6 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity (junior member, small amounts, mixed trades) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (crisis VIX, flat yield curve, rising dollar) combined with imminent earnings binary event create elevated risk environment for QRVO.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/PPO bullish crossovers with supertrend confirmation and extreme fear sentiment (21/100) create contrarian entry opportunity near support at 108.15.
debate.key_bear_argument: Imminent earnings (6 days), critical VIX crisis, price below both 50-day moving averages, negative money flow, overbought stochastic RSI, and zero fundamental/institutional support create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: MACD/PPO bullish crossovers and extreme fear sentiment (21/100) offer contrarian appeal at support, but this is insufficient to override critical macro and event risks.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 6 days combined with crisis VIX environment and price below both 50-day moving averages creates unacceptable downside risk with no fundamental conviction.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 22 positions in Information Technology sector; adding QRVO increases concentration risk without offsetting conviction.
